topic: fix-round briefs: run existing tests, never run forge inside the worker
lesson: A delegated fix must run the existing test files for every module it touches, not only its new regression, and must never run forge delegate/forge next inside the worker. LEAN-WORKFLOW round 1 shipped three regressions (dropped authority read, native plans/ patch denied, stale encoding pin) that existing tests/checks caught, and two workers paused on self-run forge commands (S-0051, S-0052).
